captions.detailed: A 3D model of the Antilia building in Mumbai, presented as a long, multi-layered architectural structure. It features a large, solid rectangular block at one end, which transitions into a series of open frames, cantilevered slabs, and vertical rectangular walls. Distinctive structural elements include horizontal cylindrical support beams spanning between sections and diagonal truss-like cylindrical columns on one of the lower levels.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric 3D model of the Antilia building in Mumbai. The model should feature a complex architectural layout with adjustable overall height, composed of distinct layered sections, vertical structural walls, and connecting horizontal and diagonal cylindrical supports.
captions.factory: The script defines the building's complex layout using multiple 2D polygon profiles representing different wall sections and floor footprints. These profiles, such as poly_rect38017 and poly_rect4597, are extruded using linear_extrude with a height parameter, scaled, and translated into position. The structural frames are constructed by combining these extruded polygons with boolean difference operations to create hollowed interior spaces and window-like cutouts.
